text:
tara (People Ops): Heads-up — Olivia's welcome crate (laptop + YubiKey + swag) shows as "delivered" by the courier but the building logged a different recipient. Olivia can't find it and is starting Day 1 tomorrow. Can we triage options?

olivia (new hire): Ugh, I just checked — I didn't sign for anything. Tracking says delivered to 'Front Desk - Suite B'. I'm at a different address on my profile. I can pick it up if it's held nearby.

tara (People Ops): Thanks — @mike can facilities confirm whether reception accepted a package today and who signed? If it's locked in a mailroom we can ask them to hold overnight.

mike (Facilities): Looking now. Front desk log shows a courier drop at 15:42 today, signed by "Reception Team" (generic). Photo on file shows a stack with a small white box and a Redwood packing slip. Could be the crate.

onboarding-bot: NOTE: For security, hardware with MFA tokens should not be left unattended more than 24h. Please escalate if pickup is delayed.

sam (IT): If the hardware's delayed, we can issue a loaner VM + temporary MFA alternative so Olivia can join Day 1 meetings. We'll also pre-provision account and Slack access.

courier-updates: Update: Tracking 1Z999AA10123456784 — Status: DELIVERED to Front Desk, Building 4, 2026-03-22 15:42 PDT. Package ID: RC-9012. Recipient: "Reception Team".

tara (People Ops): Ok plan options: 1) Ask courier for hold-for-pickup tomorrow morning at Building 4 reception (preferred). 2) Arrange pickup at nearest partner office (15 min from Olivia). 3) If hold isn't possible, ship overnight replacement (expedite) — cost ~ $85. Which is fastest?

olivia (new hire): I can go to Building 4 in the morning between 9–10. If they need a pickup code or photo ID, I have my passport.

mike (Facilities): Reception can hold and release to Olivia if she shows ID and we add her to an authorized pickup list. I'll add her name to the list now: OLIVIA-NEWHIRE.

sam (IT): I'll stage a temporary access token and a Zoom invite so she can onboard remotely if the crate is not in her hands by 9:30. Also sending instructions to register a software MFA (Authy) as a backup until the YubiKey is with her.

tara (People Ops): I'll call the courier to confirm hold. If they refuse, we ship replacement ASAP. Also heads-up to security: please allow reception to accept and release this package to Olivia tomorrow.

courier-updates: Courier note added: Hold-at-Front-Desk requested by sender. Please present signature or pickup code 7K-4C.

sam (IT): Quick checklist for Day 1 without hardware: - Zoom link + calendar ✓ - Slack invite ✓ - Temporary VPN fallback (token) - Local hotspot instructions (if no laptop) - Loaner remote desktop image: rwinf-onboarding-std 

tara (People Ops): We're good then. Olivia — can you confirm arrival time and that you'll bring ID? Also can you confirm preferred phone for pickup code?

olivia (new hire): Confirmed. I'll be there at 09:15 with passport. Phone: +1 415-555-0199. Thanks everyone! :relieved:

mike (Facilities): Added pickup authorization to reception. They'll log the pickup and send a photo confirmation to this thread once handed over.

onboarding-bot: Reminder scheduled: Day-1 hardware checklist for Olivia — 08:30 tomorrow.

courier-updates: Courier confirmation: Package RC-9012 released to Olivia at 09:22 on 2026-03-23. Pickup photo attached to courier portal.

tara (People Ops): Awesome — closing loop. sam, please follow up if Olivia needs any further IT help; mike thanks for the quick add. Olivia — welcome again, see you tomorrow! :tada:
